rules.sentence: Histologically, leiomyoma exhibits a proliferation of bland spindle cells with cigar shaped nuclei and abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm without atypia, mitosis, or necrosis.
Leiomyomas may recur when incompletely excised (Figure 5A).
Leiomyosarcoma is malignant mesenchymal smooth muscle tumor.
Histologically, leiomyosarcoma is composed of a proliferation of spindle cells with marked atypia, brisk mitotic activity with or without tumor necrosis (Figure 5B).
